messages:
drew: Noticed a weird pattern in this morning's invoice batch: a handful of EU customers got two invoices for March (one at legacy rate, one at experiment rate). Example: acme-eu: INV-2026-0742 (EUR 12,345.67) and INV-2026-0742-dup (EUR 13,580.22). Not good.

asha: ack. did the export job run multiple times? any retries showing in job history?

drew: there were 2 export attempts between 02:10 and 02:25 UTC. The first completed, then an automated retry started at 02:18 and succeeded too. Both wrote invoice rows.

tom: hmm. I pulled the audit log for the pricing experiment toggle: 
```
2026-05-03T02:17:12Z feature-toggle: tiered-pricing-eu set=true by deploy-bot
2026-05-03T02:17:13Z feature-toggle: tiered-pricing-eu propagation completed
```
So the flag flipped mid-window. Export reads pricing flags at line-item evaluation time, and retries don't dedupe previously written invoices unless `--idempotent` is used.

maria: confirmed: export job exp:eu-20260503-02 had idempotency disabled due to a prior bugfix. When retry happened, it wrote invoices again with the new pricing. Also currency rounding differs between the two code paths.

billing-bot: job exp:eu-20260503-02 COMPLETED attempts=2 idempotent=false notification=on

asha: blast radius? how many customers and how large are amounts?

drew: quick query: 9 accounts affected, totals range EUR 120 -> EUR 1.2M. The big one is acme-eu (above). We should assume duplicates for any invoice generated between 02:10 and 02:20 UTC.

tom: mitigation plan:
- Pause automated finalize/send pipeline for EU region now. (ops-bot: please hold)
- Mark suspect invoice IDs as "draft" and prevent payment processor notifications.
- Run a reconcile to detect duplicate invoice numbers and price mismatches, choose the correct canonical invoice per finance policy (prefer "finalized_at" timestamp or manual override).
- Reissue corrected invoices and void duplicates.

ops-bot: action: pause_pipeline region=eu reason="duplicate-invoice-risk" by=ops-bot timestamp=2026-05-03T03:01:00Z

maria: also note we need a permanent change: exporters must consult a snapshot of feature flags at job start and store it with the job metadata, so retries use same pricing snapshot. I'll open an RFC.

asha: agree. short term: can we patch export to set `idempotent=true` automatically if attempts>1? That would avoid double-writes on retries.

tom: yes, but need to be careful about side effects we saw before where idempotent writes masked partial failures. For this incident I can patch the pipeline to respect job.snapshot_flags if present; otherwise set idempotent=true for retries. ETA 45m.

drew: customer comms: we should draft a short note offering corrected invoice and explaining next steps. @maria can you prepare the template?

maria: will do. include clear call to action for customers who already paid one invoice. We'll coordinate refunds/crediting.

billing-bot: task create ticket=BILL-7902 assignee=tom priority=high summary="EU duplicate invoices from pricing feature toggle during export window"

asha: command to list suspect invoices (dry run):
```
./tools/billing/query --region eu --start 2026-05-03T02:05:00Z --end 2026-05-03T02:25:00Z --filter "invoice_count>1 OR price_mismatch=true" --output csv
```
Use this to generate the list for finance triage.

drew: I've exported the CSV and attached to BILL-7902. I've also flagged acme-eu invoices for manual review and hold.

tom: patching exporter now to snapshot flags at job start and to set idempotent mode for retries. Will run staging test.

maria: once we have patched and re-run reconcile, finance should validate totals before we send. Also recommend a one-off waiver for small rounding differences under EUR 1.00 so we don't block many customers.

asha: good call. anything else?

drew: keep the pipeline paused until we confirm reissue is clean. post status in BILL-7902. Thanks all. :pray:
